左右拖动换个角度: Drag sideways to change the view
阳光：太阳在你背后: Sunlight: the sun is behind you
里面鲜亮的是主虹，外面较淡的是副虹。仔细看：两圈的颜色顺序正好相反，红色都朝着中: The vivid inner arc is the primary rainbow. The fainter outer arc is the secondary. Their colours run in opposite directions: both red edges face the dark gap.
阳光进入水滴时分开颜色，在内壁反射一次，再折出水面。跟着亮点走：标着 1 的地方: Sunlight separates into colours as it enters a drop, reflects once inside, then bends again on the way out. Follow the bright dot: 1 marks the reflection. Many rays gather near 42°, forming the primary bow.
外面那道，多反射了一次: One more reflection makes the outer bow
另一部分光在水滴里反射两次才出来。跟着亮点数 1、2：多一次反射，留下的光更少，: Some light reflects twice before leaving the drop. Follow the dot past 1 and 2. Less light survives, the bright edge moves to about 51°, and the colours reverse. This makes the secondary bow.
两道彩虹，把暗带夹在中间: A darker gap between the bows
回到天空：主虹内侧和副虹外侧都有额外的雨滴散射光，两圈之间却少了这部分光，于是显: Back in the sky, raindrops add light inside the primary and outside the secondary. The gap receives less of this scattered light, so it looks darker. This is Alexander’s dark band; it is not completely unlit.
太阳升高，两道彩虹一起下沉: As the Sun rises, both bows sink
把太阳从 12° 升到 45°。主虹先落到地平线下，外圈还剩一小段。能不能看见彩: Raise the Sun from 12° to 45°. The primary slips below the horizon first; a small part of the outer bow remains. Visibility depends on the Sun’s height and the presence of droplets, not simply the time of day.
把水滴缩到雾滴大小，光的波动效应让色带变宽、互相重叠，彩虹便淡成白色的雾虹。把水: Shrink the drops to fog size. Wave effects spread the colours into wider, overlapping bands, making a pale fogbow. Enlarge the drops and the colours separate again.
你走一步，换一批雨滴送光: Take a step; different drops send you light
从侧面看，彩虹围绕你的头影方向。你向前走，送光的雨滴换了，角度却几乎不变，所以总: From the side, the rainbow surrounds the direction of your head’s shadow. Walk forward and new drops send you light at almost the same angle. That is why you cannot reach its foot. Try the arrow controls below.
回到雨后，自己找一找: Back to the rain: try it yourself
在「天空」「主虹光路」「副虹光路」之间切换，比较一次和两次反射。展开底栏，还能改: Switch between Sky, Primary ray and Secondary ray to compare one reflection with two. Expand the controls to change the Sun’s height, resize the drops, or walk and see how your rainbow changes.
跟着亮点数反射；拖动光线，看出射方向怎样改变。: Follow the dot and count the reflections. Drag the ray to change its exit direction.
雾滴让色带变宽、重叠，形成近乎白色的雾虹。: Tiny fog droplets broaden and blend the colours into a nearly white fogbow.
主虹已在地平线下；副虹要到太阳更高时才消失。: The primary is below the horizon; the outer bow lasts until the Sun rises higher.
外圈更淡、颜色反过来，两圈之间的天空更暗。: The outer bow is fainter and reversed, with darker sky between the arcs.
两道彩虹都已落到地平线下。降低太阳，彩虹会重新升起。: Both bows are below the horizon. Lower the Sun to bring them back.
主虹外红内紫。打开第二道彩虹，比较相反的颜色顺序。: The primary has red outside and violet inside. Show the secondary to compare their reversed colours.
